tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, never pure white, so the ink and volt blocks have something to sit on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on ground. Always paired with a 2px line-strong border; never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All display and body text, icons and strong borders. Black is the primary brand colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono captions and eyebrows on ground or surface. 8:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata and tertiary text only, 4.6:1 on ground; never for body copy.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 2px borders on cards, buttons and table rules. Same as ink.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines inside components: table row dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The accent. Fills only: highlighter bar behind a word, stat block, primary button, mark bar. Never used as text or as a thin line; 1.3:1 against white fails everything.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt fill. Always black, in both themes.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: The inverse block: a solid ink slab used for emphasis panels, footers, dark stat cards. In dark theme it flips to ivory.

tokens.name: on-block
tokens.usage: Text on a block fill.

tokens.name: on-block-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a block fill. 10:1.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Crash events, errors, destructive actions. Text-safe on ground (4.6:1). Not a decorative colour.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy status, passing tests, trip active. Text-safe on ground. Differs from alert in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero and poster headlines. Uppercase, one to three words per line. Only on ground or block.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines and slide titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles, stat values, pull quotes. Uppercase.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number in a StatBlock. Keep to 6 characters.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Feature and card headings in sentence case. Use when uppercase display would shout.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Firmware that has already been through production.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Modem communication, OTA updates and trace logging all work reliably.
styles.usage: Default body copy. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card body copy and table cells.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings, table headers, stat captions. Always ink-muted or on-block-muted, never volt.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.sample: <30 KB flash · 1 KB RAM · no heap
styles.usage: Specs, code, log excerpts and datasheet values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stat blocks and tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap between eyebrow and heading.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section internal spacing.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page and slide margins.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. The brand is square: buttons, cards, inputs, images and the mark all have hard corners.

border.note: Borders replace shadows and radii as the way surfaces are separated.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, outlined stat blocks. Colour line-strong.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Table rows, inputs at rest. Colour line-soft.
